z.$description: The stacking order: one z-index scale for components and the application's own layers, lowest first. Inside a component, a part one step above or below its siblings takes calc() of a level, such as calc(var(--env-z-raised) + 1).

base.$description: The flow of a page or a component; a part drawn behind its siblings takes calc(var(--env-z-base) - 1).

raised.$description: A part raised over its siblings inside a component or a region: a sticky table header, a resize handle, the hovered avatar of a group.

sticky.$description: Sticky parts that content scrolls under: a sticky TopBar or PageHeader.

supporting-pane.$description: A supporting pane that opens over its main pane as a sheet, and the backdrop behind it, above the sticky parts.

backdrop.$description: The backdrop behind a modal layer, which covers the page and the frame.

modal.$description: Modal layers over their backdrop: dialogs, sheets and the command palette.

popup.$description: Popups anchored to a control, also inside a modal layer: menus, popovers, hover cards, the lists of Select and Combobox, and suggestions.

toast.$description: Notifications, above the popups and modal layers they report on.

tooltip.$description: Tooltips, above everything they can describe.
